title: ICLR 2025 Mentoring Chats
subtitle: Part of the ICLR experience is meeting people and talking with them about their research interests and experiences. To facilitate these conversations, we are thrilled to announce the third iteration of Mentoring Chats at ICLR (previously called Office Hours). The Mentoring Chats will be 45-minute round-table sessions, held during lunch (12:30-1:15 pm and 1:15-2:00 pm) […]
